summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus — by lot the bride of Eurydamas son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos.

story.text: Apollodorus allots Phartis to Eurydamas among the seven sons of Egyptus begotten on a Phoenician woman — one of the pairings named before the mass slaughter of the wedding night.
